entities.name: Ribosomal protein bL32
observations: 64-residue bacterial protein; exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q606L1 from Methylococcus capsulatus.
Predicted molecular weight is 7,239.9 Da, theoretical pI 10.13, and charge at pH 7 is +3.95.
Pfam Ribosomal_L32p domain PF01783.30 spans residues 2–55 with i-Evalue 2.9e-21.
High-confidence functional annotation: structural constituent of the large ribosomal subunit.
Likely subcellular localization is the bacterial large ribosomal subunit; the sequence has no transmembrane segment or secretion signal evident from its short, highly basic composition.

entities.name: Q606L1
observations: Reviewed UniProt reference from Methylococcus capsulatus; exact sequence match to the query, 100% identity and 100% coverage, E-value 7.26e-40.
Annotated with GO:0015934 large ribosomal subunit, GO:0003735 structural constituent of ribosome, and GO:0006412 translation.

entities.name: Bacterial translation
observations: The protein is a component of the bacterial large ribosomal subunit and contributes to translation as a structural ribosomal protein.
